scope.note: Only introductions visible in the current Fall 2026 introduction run are included. Research tags are normalized for conversation matching; interests are reserved for clearly non-research personal/common-ground interests.
scope.project_link_note: project_url is the primary/singular SPAR Fall 2026 project link when one could be verified confidently. project_urls is the plural form and supports people associated with multiple projects. Links were verified from Slack introductions and/or SPAR's public Fall 2026 project index; unresolved titles remain unlinked rather than guessed.
scope.slack_metadata_note: Slack user IDs, message timestamps, profile links, introduction permalinks, and role metadata were refreshed directly from #introductions for the Fall 2026 run (2026-09-10 through 2026-09-13). Explicit mentors remain mentors; all other Fall 2026 introducers are treated as mentees. Older cohorts are excluded.

tag_semantics.means: Controlled-vocabulary methods, disciplines, and research approaches. Redundant broad parents are omitted from individual records when a more specific canonical child is already present.
tag_semantics.ends: Controlled-vocabulary research problems, safety goals, failure modes, and application objectives. Redundant broad parents are omitted from individual records when a more specific canonical child is already present.
tag_semantics.specific_means: Fine-grained methods, tools, and approaches supported by an introduction, project page, or confidently matched public research profile.
tag_semantics.specific_ends: Fine-grained research problems, failure modes, safety goals, and application areas supported by an introduction, project page, or confidently matched public research profile.
tag_semantics.interests: Clearly non-research personal/common-ground interests only. Research topics belong in research_tags or background_research_interests.
tag_semantics.background_research_interests: Longer-run research interests/background inferred only from confidently matched public professional or research sources; empty when external evidence was not reliable enough.

matching_guidance.recommended: Use IDF- or rarity-weighted overlap across canonical means/ends, then boost exact overlaps in specific_means/specific_ends. A rare shared specific tag should count much more than a broad bridge tag.
matching_guidance.cross_method_connection: Canonical bridge tags intentionally connect variants such as linear probes and ground-truth probes under probing; activation directions/vectors/steering under activation engineering; SAEs under sparse autoencoders; and closely related evaluation/monitoring variants.
matching_guidance.hierarchy_bridges: Treat parent tags added through tag_taxonomy.hierarchy_bridges as weak discovery signals. They exist so a broad-interest person can connect to a specialist, but they should score below a shared fine-grained specific tag.

sources_considered: personal/research websites and publications linked from introductions or public profiles
limitations: LinkedIn blocks or rate-limits many direct profile pages. Public search-indexed LinkedIn snippets were used only when the identity match was confident.
Ambiguous same-name profiles were excluded rather than used to infer interests.
Background interests are intentionally empty for people whose external research background could not be verified confidently.
Canonical tags are matching bridges, not claims that two projects are identical; fine-grained distinctions are preserved in specific_means and specific_ends.

tag_taxonomy.note: Values are cohort record counts for each canonical bridge tag; specific terms are retained per person.

hierarchy_bridges.note: Parent tags are weak discovery bridges, not equivalence claims; ranking should down-weight them relative to exact specific-tag overlap.

final_review_audit.design_note: Canonical tags are bridge concepts for discovery, but redundant hierarchy parents are no longer repeated on individual records. specific_means/specific_ends retain precise distinctions; use rarity/IDF weighting so broad tags do not dominate recommendations.
final_review_audit.spot_check_note: Manual spot checks were performed on representative cross-project clusters including probing/deception, SAE/reward-hacking monitoring, steganography/activation steering, multi-agent safety, agent security, and human-agency work.

tag_audit.design_note: Hierarchy relationships remain in tag_taxonomy for matching, but individual records avoid repeating broad parent tags when a more specific canonical child is already present.
